title: ReferenceMap
description: Bibliography + inline-citation map for the document under audit. Emitted at Stage 1 by scripts/extract_reference_map.py with paper_id null on every citation; Stage 2 fills paper_id back in after identifier resolution succeeds (via checkpoint.update_reference_map_paper_ids). bibliography_orphans[] is populated at Stage 1 (cheap deterministic check, no API calls) — bib entries with zero inline occurrences. Validated by scripts/validate_artifact.py --kind reference_map against schema + predicates M1-M3.

bibliography_orphans.description: Bibliography entry keys with zero inline occurrences in the document. Stage 7 internal-consistency input.

key.description: Citation key as it appears in the document. BibTeX key ('Smith2019'), numeric bracket ('[12]'), or author-year ('Smith et al., 2019').

paper_id.description: Stable join key. DOI-preferred, PMID fallback, slug last resort. Null until Stage 2 resolves. Byte-compatible with deep-research/schemas/sources.json#paper_id and resolved_sources.json#paper_id.

raw_text.description: Verbatim bibliography entry text (when available). Empty string when only inline mentions exist (no bib entry parsed).

occurrences.description: Locations where this citation appears inline. Empty when this is a bibliography-only entry with no inline reference (becomes a bibliography_orphan if also absent).
